notes: Every file referencing the exported IssueStatus union. Rule: adding a status forces a change wherever the union is named — the board column model, the status select, the tone map, the filter params, the optimistic reducer, the Zod enum and the repository. Files that only compare a status to a string literal are out. Derived mechanically by scripts/derive-keys.ts (ts-morph over corpus/taskflow/tsconfig.json); re-running it must reproduce this file. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root. tests/** is excluded from every key: the tasks ask about application code, and a spec that merely exercises a symbol is not a place the behaviour lives.
